title: Owner's manual clarity and format
summary: Feedback centers on how easy the owner's manual is to understand and whether customers prefer printed or online access, with many excerpts lacking a clear sentiment label.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the manual as easy to understand and express preference for having a printed book instead of using the online version.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the owner's manual and online manual are unclear, awkwardly worded, and distracting or difficult to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention online access, missing hard copies, requests for more examples, and difficulty finding information, but the sample does not always make the sentiment assignment explicit.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are labeled undetermined, which limits clear interpretation of overall customer sentiment on this topic.
Several undetermined fragments describe apparent praise or criticism, so the labeled sample contains ambiguity between topic mention and explicit sentiment.
The topic includes related but distinct issues such as manual clarity, print versus online format, missing hard-copy manuals, and desired instructional examples.
